ae27362399e3ece0.description: Job Summary : We are looking for a Storekeeper to join our F&B operation in Riyadh & Jeddah. The role is responsible for managing inventory, receiving and storing food materials and packaging, and ensuring proper stock rotation, storage conditions, and inventory accuracy. Main Responsibilities : Receive, inspect, and verify incoming deliveries against purchase orders. Organize and label stock in designated storage areas, including cold rooms and dry storage. Conduct regular physical stock counts and report discrepancies. Maintain accurate stock records through manual or system-based tracking. Monitor expiry dates and apply FIFO/FEFO to minimize waste. Issue materials to kitchen/production teams based on requisitions. Maintain cleanliness and organization of storage areas according to hygiene standards. Monitor stock levels and report low-stock items to the Procurement/Cost Control team. Ensure proper storage conditions for food items, including chilled, frozen, and dry storage. Follow basic food safety and HACCP principles for food storage. Requirements: High school diploma minimum; diploma or degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, or Business Administration is a plus. 1–3 years of experience as a Storekeeper, Warehouse Assistant, or Inventory Clerk. F&B, catering, or cold-chain/perishable goods experience is preferred. Experience handling raw materials, packaging, and finished goods. Familiarity with FIFO/FEFO stock rotation. Basic knowledge of inventory/ERP systems and Excel. Ability to read and process Purchase Orders, Delivery Notes, and GRNs. Basic accounting/inventory knowledge. Basic Arabic and English communication skills. Basic knowledge of food safety and HACCP principles. Attention to detail, reliability, honesty, and trustworthiness. Physically able to handle lifting and moving stock.

The consultant will collaborate with Project Management Offices (PMO), Finance, Engineering, and other business stakeholders to deliver integrated project costing, budgeting, forecasting, billing, capitalization, and project accounting solutions. Key Responsibilities Lead discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and solution design activities for Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM implementations. Design and configure Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM modules, including Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Control, and Project Financial Management. Define and configure project organizations, templates, classifications, transaction controls, burdening structures, capitalization rules, and accounting configurations. Monitor project risks, issues, and dependencies, ensuring timely communication to project leadership and stakeholders. Deliver user training, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness activities. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience, with a minimum of 8 years in Oracle ERP Functional consulting. Proven experience leading Oracle Fusion Cloud PPM implementations. Strong hands-on experience with Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Controls, and Project Financial Management. Experience across solution design, configuration, testing, cutover, deployment, and post-go-live support activities. This role involves identifying and flagging unclear or sensitive cases, and collaborating with reviewers and project leads to resolve annotation issues, thereby maintaining reliable datasets. The contribution of this role is critical in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data used for advanced AI and machine learning applications. Key Responsibilities Review project instructions and annotation guidelines thoroughly, seeking clarification for any ambiguities. Label, classify, transcribe, categorize, or annotate assigned data using approved tools and standards. Ensure consistent application of labels across various data formats, adhering to project requirements. Verify completed annotations for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, and correct use of defined labels. Flag ambiguous, incomplete, low-quality, or sensitive data for review instead of making assumptions. Incorporate feedback from reviewers and update annotations as required. Good reading and comprehension skills in the languages specified by the project. Basic computer proficiency and confidence in using web-based tools, spreadsheets, and annotation platforms. Ability to manage repetitive tasks while maintaining focus and accuracy. Clear written communication skills and openness to receiving and applying feedback. Work Environment and Contract Details This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a contract basis. ae6966cc65ebca83.company_name: Manar Al Omran Formwork & Scaffolding Services
ae6966cc65ebca83.description: About the Role Manar Al Omran Formwork & Scaffolding Services is seeking a Plant Manager Aluminium Extrusion for a full-time position in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, covering cities such as Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Hafuf, Buqayq, and Ras Tannurah. This senior role is the first hire for a greenfield aluminium extrusion program, encompassing the technical and operational leadership of two new plants located on a single site. Role Purpose and Scope The Plant Manager will serve as the owner's process authority during the design, procurement, and construction phases. Key responsibilities include leading the hot commissioning and ramp-up of eight extrusion presses and a billet cast house. Following commissioning, the role involves managing both plants to ensure safe operations, adherence to budgeted cost per tonne, and certified quality standards. The ideal candidate will possess extensive extrusion expertise, from presses and dies to billet production, with a proven track record of establishing a plant from an empty site to stable production. Key Responsibilities Design, Procurement, and Construction: Act as the owner's process authority for all relevant areas, approve layouts and material flow, review supplier engineering deliverables, define performance guarantees, witness factory acceptance tests, coordinate with contractors, specify initial stock, finalize plant organization, recruit teams, and prepare operating procedures, quality plans, and maintenance systems. Commissioning and Ramp-up: Lead hot commissioning and performance tests, deliver the production ramp-up plan, establish die trial and correction practices, bring the cast house into production with controlled billet quality, and obtain product and system certifications (*, EN 755, Qualicoat, ISO 9001). Steady-state Operations: Own the safety performance of both plants, plan and load eight presses, manage conversion cost per tonne, recovery, energy per tonne, and die cost per tonne within budget, implement continuous improvement through OEE, TPM, SPC, and lean methods, collaborate with Head Office functions, and develop Saudi talent for supervisory and technical roles. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in aluminium extrusion. Demonstrated experience in taking a plant from a greenfield site to stable production. In-depth knowledge of presses, dies, and billet production processes. Leadership and Personal Attributes Ability to build teams from the ground up and develop personnel new to extrusion. Hands-on approach, comfortable working on the press floor and in the cast house. Commercially aware, with an understanding of cost per tonne and how process decisions impact it. Firm in managing suppliers and contractors regarding scope, schedule, and guarantees. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, focusing on the establishment and operation of two new aluminium extrusion plants on a single site. The role involves significant leadership in a greenfield project environment.

aeb048c4ea010e3d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة يورو كونسلت للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم وتنفيذ وصيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير الإجراءات الفنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع الهندسة الكهربائية ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص الأعطال الفنية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركة المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالمشاريع الهندسية، بما في ذلك نسب التقدم، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية بدقة. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال الكهربائية ووضع حلول الصيانة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق في مقر الشركة بمدينة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً بالمهام المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة يورو كونسلت للاستشارات الهندسية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر قنوات التوظيف المتاحة.

aeed6d9ea7165e85.description: About the Role PROVEN is seeking an Event Manager for a contract position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves overseeing the end-to-end delivery of large-scale event venues and live event environments for a client operating in the esports and live entertainment industry. ae78e575f0ca4731.description: Due to national security requirements for this role, applications are strictly restricted to Saudi nationals. Applicants to this role must have work authorization in Saudi Arabia as this role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of experience working in a government or military environment, leveraging and developing Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) for network, host and log analysis, to enable the detection and response to cyber threats. Experience in leveraging CTI to describe, track and develop new intelligence on advanced persistent threats. Experience in conducting or supporting incident response and investigations within enterprise environments. Evaluate tools and best practices for tracking advanced threats, Tools, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) of attacker’s motivations, and industry and attacker trends. Perform analysis of customer data, taking their bespoke sources to identify threat activity, or to build and automate investigative workflows. Write intelligence reporting against customer requirements, appropriate for their intelligence analysts or executive leaders. Support the integration of CTI into customer's security processes and technologies, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP) systems. ae2b8e8f4d866053.description: JOB PURPOSE The Director of Enterprise Activation is the execution engine that stands QHC up as a functioning organization. Reporting to the CEO, the role owns the practical build of the corporate strategy, operating model, the mobilization of the startup, and the disciplined delivery of the transition from a preliminary structure to the target organization design. The role design and converts strategy and organization into activated capability, establishing the operating model, governance cadence, service-level framework with Qiddiya Investment Company (QIC) shared services, and the program management discipline required to launch a company startup at pace and with control. Working across every function and the wider Qiddiya ecosystem, the Director of Enterprise Development ensures interdependencies are managed, readiness milestones are met, and the leadership team has the structures, decisions and reporting it needs to move from stabilize, to operationalize, to institutionalize. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES 1. Corporate Strategy • Build the corporate strategy and execution strategic priorities and long-term growth agenda. • Evaluate emerging healthcare trends and opportunities aligned with Qiddiya’s vision. • Develop strategic planning frameworks and performance measures supporting executive decision making. 2. Organizational Design Activation & Operating Model Build • Translate the approved organization design into an activated operating model — defining roles, structures, decision rights, interfaces and ways of working across QHC functions. • Drive the activation of QHC’s core functions, defining setup requirements and activation plans and sequencing their transition toward the target operating model. • Establish the operating cadence and cross-functional interfaces that allow the organization to run and scale. 3. Startup Mobilization & Program Management • Own the enterprise program management office for the startup build, maintaining the master mobilization plan, milestones, dependencies and critical path. • Drive execution follow-up and delivery momentum across workstreams, tracking priority initiatives and decisions to closure and escalating delays, blockers and cross-functional dependencies where required. • Prepare leadership decision-support materials and maintain a single, credible view of startup progress and readiness for the CEO / MD and Board. 4. Shared Services • Define and coordinate the shared-services model through which QHC leverages QIC and wider Qiddiya ecosystem shared services (including finance, human capital, technology, …etc) during the startup phase. • Define QHC’s shared-service requirements, interfaces and ways of working, and coordinate with QIC on service arrangements, support requirements and transition activities. • Clarify which enabling and support capabilities are leveraged from the ecosystem, at what level, and where retained capabilities must sit. 5. Transition Roadmap & Milestone Delivery • Own delivery of the phased transition roadmap for both the strategy and enterprise activation including the milestones that make each phase real. • Coordinate the stand-up of new pillars and the consolidation of enabling functions in line with the target structure, adjusting sequencing as constraints emerge. • Maintain a living transition dashboard evidencing progress against the target operating model. 6. Capability & Resource Mobilization • Coordinate with Human Capital and function leads on workforce requirements and mobilization dependencies for Day-1 and subsequent activation waves. • Track function-level capability and resource requirements, priorities and gaps against the activation plan. • Coordinate the setup requirements and dependencies — including tools, workspace, policies and processes — required for functions to operate from Day-1. 6. Governance, Decision & Reporting Cadence • Establish the enterprise delivery reporting cadence, progress dashboards and escalation mechanisms required to keep startup delivery aligned. • Coordinate the leadership delivery rhythm including progress reviews, prioritization and escalation, to support timely resolution of cross-functional delivery issues. • Ensure delivery risks, dependencies, actions and blockers are documented, visible and escalated where required. 7. Risk, Interdependency & Readiness Management • Maintain the enterprise risk and interdependency register for the startup build, driving mitigation and readiness across functions. • Assess and report organizational readiness ahead of key milestones, flagging gaps in ownership, capability or infrastructure. • Coordinate contingency planning for critical Day-1 dependencies. 8. Stakeholder & Ecosystem Coordination • Serve as the primary coordination point between QHC functions, QIC, and the wider Qiddiya ecosystem on activation and operating-model matters. • Align external partners and internal teams around a common activation plan and shared milestones. • Support the leadership team in stakeholder engagement, materials preparation and decision-making. EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS A Master’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Healthcare Management, Organization Design, or a related field is required. 10+ years of progressive experience in organizational activation, transformation, operating-model design, PMO leadership or large-scale program delivery, including experience standing up new organizations, functions or greenfield ventures. Demonstrated experience mobilizing complex, multi-stakeholder programs to defined milestones, ideally within healthcare, sports, government / semi-government or large ecosystem-based environments. Experience operating within a shared-services or SLA-based model is a strong advantage. Proven ability to translate organization design and strategy into activated capability, and to run executive governance and reporting cadences. Working knowledge of the Saudi operating environment and Vision 2030 context is preferred.
